ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, fold the rectangular paper ABCD along AE so that point D falls on point F on side BC. If $\angle AEF = 75^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BAF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given the problem, we have: $\angle AFE = \angle D = 90^\circ$, $\angle EAF = \angle DAE$, $\angle BAD = 90^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle AEF = 75^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle EAF = 90^\circ - \angle AEF = 15^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle DAE = 15^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle DAF = \angle DAE + \angle EAF = 30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAF = \angle BAD - \angle DAF = \boxed{60^\circ}$.
